question: Does mean path confidence improve current-frame localization or change the wrong-output/missingness tradeoff at frozen TT/cap20/.01 across all six development windows?

numerical_contract.state_and_endpoint_path_tie: highest exact stored score, then lexicographically smallest complete path

phase_access.parent_future_visual_exception: After successful authorized worker execution, present only its verified new review media and inspect layout; no original image files or scientific JSON body access; Ryan owns judgments.

evaluation.matching: existing raw center evaluator at .01/raw10; uncertainty diagnostic only
evaluation.paired_transition_tables: 3x3 counts and exact frame lists against TT and top-one per window and per separate pool

development_interpretation.favorable_signal_against_saved_TT: For each separate pool: matched>=baseline, wrong_present<=baseline, missing<=baseline, hidden_alarms<=baseline; at least one strict match or hidden-alarm improvement across the pools. Otherwise report unchanged/mixed/unfavorable and every window regression.
limits: eight reviewed examples are not an evaluation denominator
five hidden frames cannot validate general occlusion performance
same development footage is not held-out evidence
localization matching does not certify object identity
development_interpretation.passing_signal_with_adverse_windows_labe: favorable pool totals with window regressions
